day_shape: 61 items dominated by Khamenei burial and mourning coverage on regime channels, Qatari mediation reported between US and Iran, UK statement at UNSC calling for de-escalation, and IDF strikes killing named Hamas commanders in Gaza.

threads.label: Khamenei burial and mourning cycle
threads.summary: Iranian state and IRGC-linked outlets published extensive coverage of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's burial at the Imam Reza shrine in Mashhad, including funeral prayer, family gravesite and three-night commemoration led by Mojtaba Khamenei. Defa Press and IRIB carried statements from the Guardian Council, Interior Minister, Pezeshkian and Palestinian Resistance Committees framing the funeral as national unity.

threads.label: Qatari mediation and US-Iran diplomacy
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Qatari negotiators are in Iran meeting officials to de-escalate the crisis and create conditions for broader negotiations, while a senior US official told CNN diplomacy continues despite intermittent strikes. The UK Deputy Permanent Representative Kate Foster delivered a statement at the UN Security Council calling for de-escalation and a return to diplomacy.

threads.label: Iranian retaliation warnings and Friday sermons
threads.summary: Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary warned any attack on infrastructure would meet a like-for-like response, and an Iranian official said Israel "will not be spared" after Trump floated strikes on Iranian facilities. Iran International reported Friday prayers across Iran turned into a synchronised campaign for revenge, rejecting talks with Washington and demanding retaliation.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz maritime risk
threads.summary: Defa Press cited a UK Maritime Trade Operations warning that security threats in the Strait of Hormuz remain at the highest danger level, referencing Bloomberg navigation data. IRIB reported China temporarily banned helium exports, noting a third of world helium transits the region.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hamas and Hezbollah
threads.summary: The IDF announced airstrikes killed Hamas weapons-production commander Khalil Jamal Khalil Manna in northern Gaza and Nukhba cell commander Yahya Saeed Mohammed Hamdan, who raided Re'im base on 7 October 2023. The IDF also said it demolished five Hamas tunnels spanning two kilometres in northern Gaza and dismantled Hezbollah weapons facilities in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain: power and transport
threads.summary: Iran International reported renewed hours-long power and water outages across Iran during summer heat, and IRIB said Tehran's electricity distributor will cut supply to high-consumption offices from 20 Tir. IRIB also reported free travel on Tehran metro and BRT buses ends Saturday with tickets reinstated.

threads.label: Russia partnership and UK IRGC powers
threads.summary: IRIB cited Putin envoy Medvedev saying Russia is prepared to continue strategic cooperation with Iran, and the head of Rosatom saying it is ready to start new units at Bushehr. Iran International reported Britain has enacted legislation creating powers that could allow IRGC designation under a new state threats framework.

events.title: A Hamas commander who raided the IDF's Re'im base during the October 7, 2023, onslaught, was killed in an airstrike in the southern Gaza Strip yesterday, the military announces. The IDF says the Thursday strike killed Yahya Saeed Mohammed Hamdan, the commander of a Nukhba Force cell. On October 7, Hamdan raided the Re'im base, which houses the headquarters of the Gaza Division, according to the military. Recently, Hamdan worked to advance attacks on troops, as well as restore Hamas's capabilities, and therefore he "posed an immediate threat."
